_comment: Blackout Series — Vol.8 of the Urban Social Series. October 2026.
Single source of truth for the season's numbers: the app, the brand art and
the signup posts all derive from this file so none of them can advertise a
PRIZE POOL. The handover states 402 OMR alongside 9 nights, a 14 OMR voucher
per winning player, and season prizes of 75/50/30. Those parts do not add up
to 402: 14 x 2 players x 9 nights = 252, plus 155 of season prizes, is 407.
The app derives the pool from the parts rather than carrying a typed-in
total, so it advertises 407. If 402 is the real budget, change a part here
(8 paying nights, or a 70/50/30 season split) rather than the total.
NO FINALS CUT. Session 9 is open like any other night; the season top three
on points take the season prizes. This is a change from Vol.7.
name: BLACKOUT SERIES
schedule: Mon & Wed, 5:30 PM, plus a Friday finals night
_paletteNotes: EXTENSION, not a repaint. lime and magenta keep every job they already
have; the five below are additions for jobs nothing was covering.
THE IDEA: Blackout is a blacklight. Lights out plus UV is exactly the room
this volume is named after, and the two colours it already had — neon
yellow-green and neon pink — are what highlighter pigments do under one.
Violet is the lamp they are lit by, so it belongs to the series in a way a
third neon picked for contrast would not.
uv (#7B2BFF) is a STRUCTURE colour: fills, plates, chips, the waitlist,
anything secondary. It is NOT a text colour on black — 3.1:1 against
#050505 fails at body size. Set type in ink, limePale or magenta.
limePale / limeDeep give the single lime a ladder. The target board and
the app currently fake one with opacity, which is why bands merge at
distance: 9% lime on black and 17% lime on black are nearly the same
grey-green. Real steps hold apart.
ROLES. The gap this fills is semantic, not decorative — Vol.6 had a
separate colour for live/success and this volume had none:
lime      primary, live, a night in progress
limePale  highlights, type on lime fills
limeDeep  fills and tints under type
magenta   the rare one: double points, the aperture, the one thing
that scores. Dilute it and it stops meaning anything.
uv        structure, waitlist, secondary chips, the night grid
muted     done, archived, inactive
